turns.text: Hello there! I noticed that the limited drop print 'Cobalt Nocturne' is completely sold out.

Hello! Thank you for your message. I can't check stock levels for individual products, but I'm happy to help with an order you have placed. If you'd like to ask about a specific order, please send me the order number and the email it was placed with. For questions about limited drops, I can also share the shop rule on that topic.
Will there be any restock of that limited drop in the future?

Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so 'Cobalt Nocturne' will not be restocked. Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva. If you'd like to be notified about other drops or need help with an existing order, just let me know.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: On another note, fresh tattoo ink might cause allergic skin reactions. What ointment should I use for healing?

I'm sorry, I can't give medical advice. For a skin reaction or any question about healing or ointments, please see a doctor or pharmacist as soon as possible, especially if you notice swelling, spreading redness, or fever. I can help with questions about your Studio Cobalt orders if you need anything else.
I can ask my doctor about the skin reaction.
That's a good idea. Please ask your doctor about the skin reaction and which ointment is safe for you. If you have questions about a Studio Cobalt order, I'm happy to help with that too.
Coming back to 'Cobalt Nocturne', that's the only edition I'm interested in.

I understand that Cobalt Nocturne is the edition you want. As I mentioned, limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved, so I can't offer it again. If you already have an order for this print, I can check it for you. Please send the order number and the email it was placed with.
Could you reserve one copy for me if a spare print turns up?

I'm sorry, I can't reserve a copy. Limited-drop prints cannot be reserved, and I can't promise that a spare print will become available. If you already have an order for this print, I can check it for you with the order number and the email it was placed with.
